Unit: 1 
CO: 1 
PO: 7,11,12 
PSO: 2 
Construction Project Life cycle 
Overview of Construction project, Stages of Construction Project: Concept, 
design, 
procurement, 
Construction, 
operation 
and 
Maintenance. 
Construction Project organizations,  Processes in Project Management as 
per project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK-7) 
8 Hrs.

CO: 1 
PO: 2,3 
PSO: 2 
Basics of Project management and introduction to PMBOK 
Management 
art 
or 
science, 
Project 
Objectives, 
Scientific 
Project 
Management, Classical management, functions of Management, Principles 
of Project Management &  Performance domain as per Project Management 
Body of Knowledge (PMBOK-7) 
8 Hrs. 
Unit: 3 
CO: 1 
PO: 2,7 
PSO: 2 
Models, Methods and Artifacts  
Models: Situational leadership models, OSCAR Model, Communication 
Models, Motivation Models, Change Models, Complexity Models, Project 
Team Development Models 
Methods:  Data Gathering Methods, Estimating, Meetings and Events 
Artifacts: Strategy Artifacts, Logs and Register, Plans, Hierarchy Charts, 
Baseline, Visual data and Information, Reports, Agreements and Contracts 
10 Hrs.

CO: 2 
PO: 3,11

Project Initiating and Planning  
Define requirement, Project Scope statement, WBS and Activity List, 
Network Diagram, Critical Path, Estimate Resource requirement, Develop  
schedule, budget and quality standards, Team Charter and roles and 
responsibility, Types of Management plans, Kickoff Meeting  and Ground 
rules 
 8 Hrs.

PO: 2,12

Project Controlling and Monitoring  
Measure Performance against baseline and project management plan, 
analyze and evaluate data, Earn value concept, Integrated change control, 
Monitor Stakeholder engagement, Perform Quality Control. Create 
Forecast, Resource management 
8 Hrs. 
Unit: 6 
CO: 2 
PO: 11,12 
PSO: 2 
Introduction to Agile Project Management  
Definable work Vs High Uncertainty work, Agile Manifesto and Mindset, 
Lean and Kanban Methods, Uncertainty, risk  and lifecycle selection 
4 Hrs. 
Recommended Reference Books: 
1. Modern Construction Lean Project Delivery and integrated Practices 
(Industrial Innovation) by Lincoln H. Forbes & Syed M. Ahmed. 
2. Modern Construction Management by Frank Harris , Ronald Mccaffer 
3. Engineering Economics by Paneerselvam 
4. Construction Project Management by Kumar Jha 
5. PMBOK-7th edition by PMI-US 
6. Agile practice guide

Course Contents: 
Unit: 1 
CO: 1 
PO: 1,2,7 
PSO: 2 
Basics of lean  
Definition of Lean, History and Development of Lean , Mass Production Vs 
Lean Production, Toyota Way, History of Lean Construction 
6 Hrs. 
Unit: 2 
CO: 1 
PO: 7,11,12 
PSO: 2 
Value, Value stream , Identify customer values through a dialogue with 
specific customers ,  Introduce the Lean thinking Approach by 
Identification of Value-added and non-value added activities in their daily 
works, Value stream theory – Value stream mapping to identify wastes and 
waste-prone areas in processes 
10 Hrs. 
Unit: 3 
CO:1 
PO: 2,3 
PSO: 2 
Concept of Flow – Flow in systems – Flow & Predictability Production 
systems in Manufacturing vs Construction - Mass Vs Craft – Flow in 
Manufacturing Production systems – Flow in Construction Production 
systems – Benefits of flow based production systems and illustrations. 
6 Hrs. 
Unit: 4 
CO: 2 
PO: 5,6,7,8 
PSO: 2 
Flow in Push/Pull systems – How these concepts relate to Construction – 
Push/pull in construction at different levels (different phases-EPC, with in 
construction), Kaizen – PDCA and Continuous Improvement, Impact of 
perfection – Impact of variability and control of Variability – Process metrics 
– Production capacity, production rate, Buffer, Wasted Time(utilization) 
10 Hrs. 
Unit: 5 
CO: 2 
PO: 8, 10 
PSO: 2

change in the organization – Team building and Training –Lean Maturity

Concept of people (Motivation, Group Dynamics), Developing process maps 
- Explanation of the process in terms of concepts and correlation with 
product

ULO

be able to 
ULO1 Understand basic Lean concept 
ULO2 Understand Value and Value stream in projects 
ULO3 Understand Flow and flow based project processes 
ULO4 Analyze Pull and Push alternative for Project control 
ULO5 Analyze project scenario for Lean management 
ULO6 Analyze Project scenario to Develop  process maps
